updates.note: Management stated EBITDA margin was 20.8% for the full year FY26, essentially delivering around the 21% level.
updates.quote: And, EBITDA growth margin is for the year 20.8%.

new_promises.statement: Expect 30% year-on-year revenue growth in solution and products in FY27.
new_promises.quote: We expect 30% year-on-year revenue growth in solution and products, and we hope it will increase over the period.
new_promises.speaker: Kishor Patil

new_promises.statement: Expect EBITDA margin to be between 20.5% and 21.2% for FY27.
new_promises.quote: EBITDA 20.5 to 21.2 post increasing investment in AI solutions and products competency development and new markets.
new_promises.speaker: Kishor Patil

new_promises.statement: Expect EBITDA margin to reach between 22% and 24% in the medium term.
new_promises.quote: So we expect the EBITDA to be between 22% to 24% from where we are today.
new_promises.speaker: Kishor Patil

new_promises.statement: Expect solution and product share of revenue to move to 60% in 3 years.
new_promises.quote: this 15% is solution and product, which will move to 60% in 3 years.
new_promises.speaker: Kishor Patil
